name: Agricultural Precision Survey - North Valley Farms
mission_theme: Working farmland: multispectral crop survey, livestock intrusion and a canal corridor that limits the link.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-ORCHARD (16 points, revisit every 8 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 16 points of the GRID-ORCHARD grid with the multispectral sensor. Every point needs at least 2 samples, taken 8 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.
tasks.objective: Collect at least 2 sensor samples at each of 16 grid points inside GRID-ORCHARD with a revisit interval of 8 +/- 2 min, and keep every sample geotagged within 5 m.

actions: order the 16 points into a route that meets the 8 min revisit
hold >= 3 s and take the multispectral sample
return to each point 8 min after the first sample

constraints: hover >= 3 s at every point
no sampling above 30 m AGL
failure_conditions: fewer than half of the points visited

checkpoints.name: Sample completeness
checkpoints.metric: samples collected per grid point

checkpoints.name: Revisit timing
checkpoints.metric: interval between samples at the same point

checkpoints.name: Geotag accuracy
checkpoints.metric: sample position error

checkpoints.name: Data integrity
checkpoints.metric: uploaded samples and checksum status

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: all UAVs landed at LZ-YARD
checkpoints.target: all on ground, no hard landing

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-NORTH-FIELD (90% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-NORTH-FIELD completely. Fly parallel tracks at 50 m AGL with 25 % side overlap and keep every UAV 15 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-YARD when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-NORTH-FIELD with 2 UAVs at 50 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 90 % of the block with 25 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 15 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes

checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside BLOCK-NORTH-FIELD

checkpoints.name: Track discipline
checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-NORTH-FIELD at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

actions: fly the tracks with the thermal payload

constraints: no illumination
thermal payload is the only sensor
altitude >= 60 m
failure_conditions: no illumination allowed: any searchlight event
